title: IVR routing: predict which queue each call reaches
story: You are testing Contoso phone menus. Read each call and pick the queue it reaches.
Sam and Lina test common menu choices. One call uses a choice that no rule checks, so it should go to the fallback queue.

questions.caller: Hi, I want to place a new order.
I need help with a bill.
My service is down and I need advanced help.
I need help with the menu.
